title: Appeal of Ed Fitzsimmons v. Evangel Presbytery
disposition_detail: The SJC declared the appeal administratively out of order because it was not timely filed under BCO 42-2; no merits determination was made.
first_summary: Ed Fitzsimmons appealed a decision of Evangel Presbytery, but the SJC declared the appeal administratively out of order because it was not timely filed with the Stated Clerk of the General Assembly within the 30-day period required by BCO 42-2. The SJC did not reach the merits.
summary: The SJC refused to hear Ed Fitzsimmons's appeal from Evangel Presbytery because his appeal was not filed with the General Assembly's Stated Clerk within the 30-day deadline of BCO 42-2. The appeal was declared administratively out of order, and no merits question was decided. The sparse record shows a straightforward application of the filing deadline; it does not disclose the underlying presbytery action or any merits view.
